title: Chapter 100: What Happened to Fei Youliang?
html:
The phone slipped from his fingers and struck the floor. A voice continued calling from the speaker.

“I can’t reach Youliang. What happened to you two in there?

“Xiao Zhu? Can you hear me?

“Zhu Jianing? Are you all right? Talk to me!”

Zhu Jianing heard every word, but speech had deserted him. His eyes rolled back, and he collapsed like wet laundry.

“Didn’t I warn you not to take pictures or record inside the Haunted House? Why didn’t you listen?” Chen Ge removed his mask and pocketed it. One glance at Zhu Jianing convulsing on the floor gave him a renewed appreciation for the waiver.

His methods differed from those of ordinary Haunted Houses. Elsewhere, costumed actors lurked around blind corners and leaped out with screams. Chen Ge built an atmosphere and let visitors walk into the terror themselves. They received no warning of what awaited them.

Preparation offered little protection—Zhu Jianing was the perfect example. With no release, the fear inside him lodged in his throat like ice, stealing his breath and chilling him to the bone.

Chen Ge exited the third cubicle, picked up the phone, and slid it inside Zhu Jianing’s pocket before dragging the man out of the toilet and depositing him in the corridor.

Why haven’t the spasms stopped? But he’s still breathing, so he should be fine.Chen Ge applied pressure to the man’s temples, and when Zhu Jianing’s pupils regained focus, he said, “Can you hear me? Where is your friend who came in with you?”

There was no answer, so Chen Ge had to give up on the man. “Stay put, or else you might run into an actual ghost.”

To avoid terrifying the other visitor beyond speech, Chen Ge removed his bloodied costume and tucked it under one arm.

This man came running out of the girls’ dormitory, so his friend should still be there.

Chen Ge ran toward the dormitory, but even after he searched through all the bedrooms, he could not find Fei Youliang.

Where did he go?He stopped at the room with the Pen Spirit. The pen that he had fixed with tape was broken once more and was lying on the floor.

There’s no sign of a struggle. Where did the man with glasses go?Chen Ge left the girls’ dormitory and returned to the junction. Did he take the other path?

The other path led toward the offices and the deep well. Beyond several offices, Chen Ge finally found Fei Youliang. He was in even worse condition than Zhu Jianing: foam ringed his lips, and his glasses lay shattered. Stranger still, he had collapsed beside the well at the corridor’s end, one hand gripping its rim as though he had been trying to pull himself inside.

What happened to this guy? It looks like he angered more than the Pen Spirit!Without surveillance in the new scenario, Chen Ge had no way to know.

At the sight of his battered state, Chen Ge checked his pulse.

The man’s condition is very similar to He San’s when he first visited the Haunted House. I’d better get him out of here first.

After considerable effort, Chen Ge dragged both men to the scenario entrance. He pried up the boards and had barely hauled them onto the first floor when an argument erupted outside. The people from Qin Guang’s studio seemed to be trying to force their way in.

Nothing but trouble today.With an arm beneath each visitor, he dragged both men outside and dropped them before Qin Guang’s studio. His gaze swept the group. “What’s all this commotion?”

Two vigorous young men had entered. Two lifeless husks emerged, one foaming at the mouth. Had fear made him vomit?

The surrounding crowd immediately took a step back to clear a space for them.

“Xiao Zhu! Youliang!” The people from Qin Guang’s studio immediately rushed over to help them off the ground. Zhu Jianing was recovering; he now responded to others at least, but his legs were still weak.

Fei Youliang was worse. His eyes remained open, yet he gave no response when they called his name. His face was vacant, and foam leaked from one corner of his mouth.

“What have you done to them?” the middle-aged man demanded.

“Why ask me? How would I know?” Chen Ge spoke honestly. They had already been in that condition when he found them.

“We talked to each other earlier. Xiao Zhu said that your employees stepped on Youliang’s shoulders! How dare you allow your workers to assault the visitors? We are definitely going to sue!”

“Who saw my employees assault him?” Chen Ge glanced at the pair on the ground. “Call the police if you like. I guarantee they won’t find anyone’s fingerprints on those two except their own.”

“Stop arguing. I’ll call the park doctor. Helping them comes first.” Uncle Xu could feel a headache forming.

“They’re in this state, and you still refuse to admit your fault? Thankfully, we came prepared!” The middle-aged man opened Fei Youliang’s backpack and pulled out the laptop from within. Then he connected the wireless camera from Fei Youliang’s chest and the audio recorder attached to the backpack to the laptop.

“You certainly came prepared.” While dragging the two “bodies” outside, Chen Ge had noticed the cameras and guessed their true purpose. He did not mind. Other Haunted Houses banned recording to protect expensive set designs. That was no concern for him. Every completed Trial Mission brought a new scenario, and no competitor could match his speed of expansion.

As far as he was concerned, their footage was free advertising. More than anything, his Haunted House needed exposure.

“You won’t be so smug once we play this. I’ll preserve the footage of your employees assaulting our people as evidence!” the middle-aged man declared loudly, playing to the gathering crowd.

“We are consummate professionals. We never laid a finger on your people. How many times must I repeat myself?” Chen Ge wandered over to the laptop, curious to learn what had happened to Fei Youliang and how he had ended up beside the well.

The man straightened the laptop and played the recording. The screen remained black while indistinct noises crackled from the speakers. Fei Youliang had not yet entered the Haunted House; he must have activated the recorder before taking out the camera, leaving them with sound but no image.

Several seconds later, Chen Ge’s voice could be heard from the computer.

“Let me remind you, the last person who made a claim like yours came out on his back.”

Then Fei Youliang’s condescending laugh followed. “You’ve only managed to arouse my interest even more.”
